programmes.d: The teams are challenged to put a twist on some classic Italian dishes, with a top reward for the winning group and a morale-sapping punishment for the losers.
The chefs pair up and taste dishes containing both a land and sea element; the team who identifies all proteins correctly, with the fastest time, wins.
Back at Hell's Kitchen, the chefs receive a surprise phone call from Chef Ramsay saying that there is no dinner service, but someone will be going home.
It's time for the iconic Blind Taste Test. The winners enjoy a helicopter ride, while punishment awaits the losers. Both teams struggle during service, but who will be sent home?
With eight chefs left in the team challenge, the red and blue team are each responsible for creating five different burgers: beef, chicken, lamb, salmon and turkey.
The chefs compete in the inaugural 'Spell's Kitchen' word scramble challenge and cook-off; HK is closed to the public and hosts a multi-course meal for charity.
Back at Hell's Kitchen, the chefs will compete in three difficult challenges to prove if they are worthy of a Black Jacket.
In the first challenge with all black jackets, the chefs will be competing to make a unique dish with ingredients appearing along the way.
The chefs have 30 minutes to prep and 30 minutes to serve 40 portions of food to club-goers, who will then judge.
The finalists face one more challenge before their final dinner service, and they're each paired with a Sous Chef to prepare.
Both teams prepare for the most important dinner service of their lives.
Twelve aspiring restaurateurs compete before chef Gordon Ramsay as he works to open a world-class restaurant in Los Angeles and discover the country's next culinary star.
After barely making it through opening night, the contestants feel the pressure as they prepare for their second dinner service.
The contestants prepare for their third dinner service and chef Ramsay selects another contestant to leave Hell's Kitchen.

Chef Gordon Ramsay puts aside the battle of the sexes and switches the chefs to even out the teams. The teams are put to the test during a lunch service cooking for a group of highly demanding customers.
On the restaurant's fifth night, Chef Gordon Ramsay has the contestants make and serve an entire Italian-themed menu.
As the teams prepare for their sixth dinner, chef Ramsay tells them that each team must create its own menu.
The wannabe chefs must combine their skills and work as individuals for the first time. The prize is a trip with Chef Ramsay to get a taste of the restaurant at the Red Rock Casino Resort.
The remaining contestants must create a meal fit for service in 15 minutes out of a tray of leftovers from the previous night.
The final three contestants must serve an entire dining room.
Chef Ramsay divides Hell's Kitchen between the two remaining contestants, who design a decor and a menu, then come up with names for their halves.
For the first time ever, Chef Ramsay has relocated 'Hell's Kitchen' to Las Vegas, to find out who will be the next head chef at the brand-new Hell's Kitchen restaurant in beautiful Lake Tahoe.

The chefs take on a shrimp challenge in which one hopeful makes a grave error, before a tough opening service for both teams. With Lisa Vanderpump and Wayne Brady in the VIP booths, the pressure is on.
The day begins with a Caesar salad challenge. As service begins, Olympic gold medallist Apolo Ohno and NFL star Marshall Faulk take the VIP seats.
Trouble brews in the Red team, with Amber questioning their choice of head chef. The challenge sees the teams tackling a reception for newlyweds, before a difficult service.
The teams are tasked with creating Mexican dishes, but only one can enjoy a treat, with the others having to clean out the animal pens. Later, a shock is in store at service.
